statement: Official Codex CLI documentation presents one terminal loop for exploring code, planning changes, editing files, running local tools, steering an active turn, and continuing follow-up work in the same session.

display_text.zh-CN: Codex CLI 官方文档将其描述为一个终端内的连续工作循环：探索代码、规划修改、编辑文件、运行本地工具、在执行中 steering，并在同一 session 中继续后续工作。

evidence.title: Codex CLI — Inspect, edit, and run code from your terminal
evidence.locator: Work against your local repository; Keep the coding loop in your terminal
evidence.notes: Supports the documented product behavior only; it does not establish internal loop implementation details.

notes: Source-code mapping, request protocol, retry behavior, and exact termination logic are not asserted by this claim.
